title: Brazil
text:
Brazil is a big country in South America. The country is very large. The Amazon River is in the north. Brasília is the capital city.

The Atlantic Ocean is on the east. There are many beautiful beaches on the coast. Many people visit Rio de Janeiro. It is a big and famous city.

questions.text: What is the capital city of Brazil?
Which ocean is on the east of Brazil?
Why do many people visit the beaches on the coast?
options: They want to enjoy the sun and the sea
They want to study the mountains
They want to live in the desert

questions.text: What kind of country is Brazil?
options: A very large country with many different places

vocabulary.definition: a large area of land with its own government and people
the city where the government of a country is
areas of sand or stones next to the sea
the land along the edge of the sea

paragraph_translations: O Brasil é um país grande na América do Sul. O país é muito grande. O Rio Amazonas fica no norte. Brasília é a cidade capital.
O Oceano Atlântico fica no leste. Há muitas praias bonitas na costa. Muitas pessoas visitam o Rio de Janeiro. É uma cidade grande e famosa.
